subject.title: [Feature]: Add X-Actual-Model header to expose runtime model in HTTP responses

question: What actual-runtime-model metadata contract should Gateway expose for non-streaming and streaming OpenAI-compatible responses?
rationale: The source gap is real, but normal response headers cannot cover late fallback selection after SSE headers flush, so implementation needs maintainer intent on the public API shape.

options.title: Define unified HTTP/SSE metadata
options.body: Document and implement a single actual-model contract for Chat Completions and Responses across non-streaming metadata and streaming SSE-compatible metadata.

options.title: Limit first pass to non-streaming
options.body: Expose actual-model metadata only where it is known before headers are sent, and document streaming attribution as a limitation or follow-up.

options.title: Defer to broader runtime metadata
options.body: Keep the transport response surface deferred until the overlapping resolved-model/session-status contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Define unified HTTP/SSE metadata
recommendation.body: Document and implement a single actual-model contract for Chat Completions and Responses across non-streaming metadata and streaming SSE-compatible metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact Gateway HTTP contract gap and has the strongest current API-contract routing signal among the likely owners.
